summary: This bill updates the federal poverty line calculation by requiring the Secretary of Health and Human Services to annually revise it based on a comprehensive set of household expenditures, including food, housing, childcare, and healthcare costs, adjusted for inflation and regional variations, and to publish these revised poverty lines for different household sizes and geographic areas.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly aims to update the federal poverty line calculation to expand eligibility for and utilization of federal assistance and benefits. By redefining poverty to include more accurate costs of basic needs, regional variations, and changing spending norms, it would inherently make more people eligible for social safety net programs, thus expanding welfare.
